services.title: Diagnostics and check engine work
services.body: The fault gets traced to its actual cause before anything is replaced, so you pay for the part that failed and not the three beside it.

evidence.text: James ran a diagnostic on my engine.
evidence.also: We needed an alternator diagnosis and repair on a Saturday morning for our out of state daughter.

services.title: Engine repair
services.body: The engine comes apart far enough to find the actual fault, not far enough to run up the bill.

evidence.text: I took my car to him same day and he replaced my engine coolant thermostat sensor in no time!
evidence.also: James ran a diagnostic on my engine.

services.title: Brakes
services.body: Pads, rotors and calipers are checked as a set and the worn ones come off beside the new ones, so you can see what was actually changed.

evidence.also: He was able to get me in the next morning to replace my caliper.

services.title: Steering, suspension and alignment
services.body: Worn steering and suspension parts come off, the replacement goes on beside them, and the alignment is set on the rack afterwards.

services.title: Oil changes and routine maintenance
services.body: Oil, filters and fluids are done to the schedule the manufacturer set, with what we found written on the ticket.

evidence.text: Will be going to him for basic car maintenance and repair !
evidence.also: I called Friday before Christmas for an oil change and he said he could see me on Saturday at 10 am.

reviews.author: Justin Robison
reviews.text: Best service, quickest turnaround and there is no fluff or filler. He does the job at a VERY reasonable cost and does way better than the dealership. Super forthright and very transparent about what you need without getting into deeper costs, or more money spent. I recommend all of my family and friends to go here. I drive 4 hours out of my way for this service and attention.

reviews.author: Dan Dubya
reviews.text: Hands down the best shop I've ever dealt with. I had James install a cam kit on my Caprice last year & everything went absolutely amazing. The time frame, cost & contact throughout the build process surpassed all expectations I had going into it. Since then he's went out of his way to help me with my other vehicles, gave me pointers on fixing smaller things remotely & has just plain been an all around absolute blessing.... There aren't enough characters available here for me to say how thankful I am for everything he's done for me. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!!!

reviews.author: Christine Chase
reviews.text: I've been taking my family's cars to James for 2 years & I cannot recommend him enough! He is honest, extremely knowledgeable & he takes the time to explain recommended repairs. To top it off, his prices are very fair!

reviews.author: Eric Novak
reviews.text: This shop and James are truly amazing. We needed an alternator diagnosis and repair on a Saturday morning for our out of state daughter. He got her in right away. Made a good diagnosis and repair and had it back to her quickly. As a parent with a daughter 1000 miles away from home we could not be more thrilled. Thank you from Michigan. We are so so thankful. Car running perfectly. We highly recommend this shop for your service needs.

reviews.author: Jennifer Stephens
reviews.text: James was great. I had a check engine light pop up. I took my car to him same day and he replaced my engine coolant thermostat sensor in no time! James even fixed my windshield wiper hose that nobody could seem to fix. He was very professional and I will definitely go back! I 10/10 recommend!!!

reviews.author: Linnette Bohner
reviews.text: Our family was on our way to Greenville when our alternator died in Westminster, SC. We called around to so many mechanics but they were all closed for the weekend. I called Hometown Car Care at 8:30pm and he answered and said he would be more than happy to fix our van! We got our van towed there that night and he had it done by 9:30am the next morning. He charged us such a reasonable amount and he was such an incredibly nice man and very professional. We will be taking our cars to him from now on. He is worth the drive!

reviews.author: Rico Hamilton
reviews.text: Very good mechanic and fixed in a very timely matter. Also communicated and went above on beyond on pricing and had a great attitude. Highly recommend. He's definitely my new mechanic.

reviews.author: preston cobb
reviews.text: Was screwed over by previous shops building this car. Brought it to James he got me right with a new LS swap Holley efi and pro dash install… couldn’t be happier with the service and communication definitely wouldn’t trust any other shop but Hometown Car Care for all of my vehicles… thank you again

reviews.author: Lindsay Adams
reviews.text: He was able to get me in the next morning to replace my caliper. He didn't laugh at my horrible rigging, and finished within an hour. He was more than gracious on his pricing... I literally hugged him.

reviews.author: Cynthia
reviews.text: James is an awesome mechanic & a good person! He takes pride in what he does for a living you can tell when you meet him! He’s honest, fast & very reasonable with his pricing but overall he’s your man to call when your in a bind with a vehicle prob that needs immediate attention like my jeep had this week! He let me bring it in Sunday checked out my dangerous jeep wobble steering issues in a few hours he told me I needed a new track arm he had it delivered next morning on Monday & had me on the road happily without that worry!! Cam’t thank you enough James fior your kindness & your immediate response to my problem with my wrangler! I def have myself a new mechanic now thanks to you! Blessed & appreciate you so much! Cindy in Salem sc

reviews.author: Miles Nuckolls
reviews.text: Absolutely excellent service. Bought a used car, and brought it to him to double check everything. He gave me an honest and fair assessment of the entire vehicle. I will absolutely be using him for all of my service needs, and you should too if you want a mechanic you can trust.

reviews.author: James Key
reviews.text: Brakes started to grind. Stopped in, James checked them out and ordered the parts. Came back the next day and was gone in 2 hours. Great service! Great guy! A pleasure to meet him and I just found my new mechanic!! A BIG THANK YOU!!!

reviews.author: Richard Medina
reviews.text: James got me in as fast as he could did an amazing job, Very reasonable pricing, friendly and fast service AAA +++ would highly recommend !!!

reviews.author: Roger Imes
reviews.text: I was driving my Smart car between Arizona and South Carolina in July when the air conditioning failed in Texas. My daughter said I could trust Hometown Garage to do the work right, so I called first, because not everyone works on Smart cars. “No problem we can fix it”, was like music to my ears. The work was done quickly and done right in a day, and at a very reasonable price, you cannot ask for more than that. Thank you very much. This review was written for Yoders Car Repair and posted here by my error.

reviews.author: Alec Sanchez
reviews.text: Incredibly helpful, had my caliper done through Memorial Day weekend and extremely fair, will go again in the future.

reviews.author: Dave Paske
reviews.text: Amazing and fast service from James. Our Freshman daughter from Clemson needed some service for her car. We called and James said to bring it over and he would try to help. He was so good that she didn't even have time to get out of her car before he diagnosed and repaired two separate issues. Cost was very reasonable and service was incredible. Thank you from an out of state Dad!

reviews.author: Bryan McCall
reviews.text: James was very knowledgeable about the mechanics of my Dodge Grand Caravan. Super nice and willing to work with me on getting my van running appropriately. Got me in fast and got me up and running great and the best part was it was less than he quoted me. Would definitely recommend Hometown Car Care.

reviews.author: Mistie Hutchins
reviews.text: I cannot recommend Hometown Car Care enough! James was honest, friendly, patient with all my questions and extremely reasonable prices. He was fast at fixing my issues on my 2001 toyota.10/10 recommend.

reviews.author: Ben Sarcia
reviews.text: I am pleased to add a 5-star review for James' work. Having identified a problem with my vehicle and being 600 miles from home, I reached out to James and he was able to replace the worn part and get me back in my vehicle within 24 hours for a price far lower than what I had anticipated.

reviews.author: Joe Dunkleman
reviews.text: We were in a tight spot with both of our cars being down at the same time. One car was already at an our normal car repair shop and it was going to be about two weeks before they would be able to look at it. As I was being picked up from another car repair shop for our other car, my uber driver told me about James. I called him and asked if he could see one of our cars since it was going to be two weeks. He asked what kind of car we had and what was going on and had it diagnosed spot on over the phone. I picked it up at the other repair shop and took it to him. Within 15 minutes of meeting him, he had confirmed his diagnosis and had parts on the way. After the parts arrived, he changed out the burnt out part and had our Nissan Rogue up and running in 5 minutes. I called him a couple days later after our other car had yet to be looked at and brought it over to him. He took care of our Volkswagen Tiguan within a few days and had it up and running well with true VW parts. James really knows his cars and all of their problems. He is honest, efficient and quick with his repairs. We will only go to James for any other vehicle issues we have. He really knows how to treat his customers the right way and do right by them and by their cars.

reviews.author: Melanie Kemp
reviews.text: I had a coolant hose bust open and needed it fixed asap. Amazingly, took my car in and had it ready to be picked up in an hour on a Saturday! A lot of shops don't stay open past 5, let alone open on the weekends. I'm always a little iffy about shops, but he did amazing work for a great price. Definitely reliable and kind, my new go-to!

reviews.author: Katie Johnson
reviews.text: I’m very impressed in doing business with James! He is a very honest man who wants to truly give you the honest cost for parts and labor. He saved our family over a thousand dollar in comparison to what a dealership was trying to tell us for repairs. He also is one of the very few who works on Hybrids in town. Without a doubt recommend going to Hometown Car Care! We plan to bring our other car to him for long awaited repairs we’ve needed done. My husband and I are beyond thankful!!!

reviews.author: C Mc
reviews.text: I highly recommend James for your car care needs! I needed headlights replaced (not bulbs but the entire light). I was told by another mechanic that I needed a body shop. However, James popped those bad boys in there with no problem! He saved me a lot of money and I would definitely use him again!

reviews.author: Rayven Craft
reviews.text: Amazing. He fixed my car within the day even with it needing a special part. He answers quickly and he knows exactly what he is doing. Also has real good prices I needed a new throttle body and he only charged me 500 and I have a Foreign car. Will be going to him for basic car maintenance and repair !

reviews.author: bill blohm
reviews.text: James is amazing. I called Friday before Christmas for an oil change and he said he could see me on Saturday at 10 am. When arriving he was ready to go with the oil and filter in hand. He was finished in under 30 minutes and his price was reasonable. James is knowledgeable about cars (new and not so new) and someone you can trust. I definitely recommend Hometown Car Center in Seneca.

reviews.author: kevin lark
reviews.text: Had a brake issue and James was able to get my car in the shop same day. He was quick to diagnose the issue and gave me a full breakdown of all costs broken down by parts and labor. His pricing was very reasonable for the work performed. I will be using him exclusively going forward for all my car repairs. I highly recommend him to anyone needing a good, reliable mechanic.

reviews.author: Anna Guevara
reviews.text: James is professional, honest, prompt and fair. My Mini Cooper is running great! Highly recommend, and will definitely return anytime I have an issue. Thanks James!

reviews.author: victor kees
reviews.text: Water pump failed while my son was 400 miles from home the last day of family vacation. James repaired the 2013 dodge ram fast ( 2.5 hours) and very professionally. Highly recommend this shop to anyone. Thank you Mr James!

reviews.author: Angela Henderson
reviews.text: Contacted James about an issue with my car Saturday evening told me to bring the car in the next morning, diagnosed the issue and had my car fixed and running by Monday afternoon. Fast, excellent services, reasonably priced and honest. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Tasha Pendergrass
reviews.text: He did great! I called him midday and by 4:30 car fixed. Explained everything to me and showed me so I could understand. Great pricing! My car is running good! Definitely would recommend him!! Very honest!! Thank you!

reviews.author: Seth Anderson
reviews.text: The names says it all! I contacted Hometown Car Care in search of a mechanic to take a look at a high pitched squealing noise coming from under my hood on Sunday morning, and I was able to have my car back within hours. James is very down to earth, honest, and you can tell he cares about his work. I recommend HCC 100 %!!

reviews.author: Racheal Timmons
reviews.text: I was traveling from GA to NC when my car started having trouble accelerating, very long story short there was only one mechanic that was open on a Sunday and the only way to avoid a 2000-dollar tow, I called James on good faith, and he had me moving in a few hours. I was and still am so thankful I came across his number, I wish I could stick him in my back pocket !!! very dependable, very nice, very quick. I could compliment him all day honestly, thank you James

reviews.author: Mark R.
reviews.text: James is a rock star. I brought in my 2011 Nissan Altima in for an Oil Change and the heater was not blowing out hot air. He quickly diagnosed what the problem was, thermostats, repaired it and I was on my way all for under $250. I highly recommend James.

reviews.author: Daniel Reid
reviews.text: My driving belt suddenly snapped and disabled my car while I was driving from NC to Greenville. I sat on the side of the road for 3 hours calling tow trucks, repair shops, and Ubers. None of them offered repairs or the tactfulness to ensure I'd get home. I called Hometown Car Care because they were the only service still open at 7pm. Almost immediately the gentleman on the phone patiently had me evaluate the car and was on his way to pick up parts and perform the repair. He got there in under an hour and completed the repair in less than five minutes. Thanks isn't enough for these folks... they deserve sainthood.

reviews.author: Melanie Harris
reviews.text: I called James on a Saturday evening and he agreed to do work for us on Sunday. He was very reasonably priced and an all around good guy. We will definitely be recommending his service to others.

reviews.author: angelina t
reviews.text: I met James yesterday. After going to 7 different mechanics in a 1 year period they all made me feel like I was crazy saying the smell under my hood is normal. I knew something wasn't right and He diagnosed my car and fixing it for me monday. I am in. Wheelchair and have no one to pick me up when dropping car off. James offered to come pick up my car!! I am so excited to have my car fixed,James sir ty very much and I'll see you Monday morning!! He is fixing it for me monday so I can make it to Dr on Tuesday.

reviews.author: Marcia Natal
reviews.text: Great guy and highly knowledgeable. I was in town with my husband and mother and our car wouldn’t start. James went the extra mile to fix our car and help us out. I highly recommend him.

reviews.author: Beth Martin
reviews.text: My grandmothers brakes started screaming while she was here visiting with me from three hours away. Hometown was the only place in town open on a Sunday. I’m so glad he was. Wonderful, fast, friendly and reasonably priced service. He was a lifesaver for us! I’d recommend him to anyone.

reviews.author: Kenneth Williams
reviews.text: James has definitely earned my customer satisfaction. He took time to work me in at a last minute notice to service and recharge my A/C system. He even showed me where the cabin Filter is for the A/C. I stopped at Napa and bought the filter and installed. Altogether cost was $160 plus filter $10. I will definitely give him more business.

reviews.author: Jennifer Vinson
reviews.text: Very fast didn’t have to drop off an come back or nothing. Great for my little family cause we need our car. It was even kid friendly! James has been fixing my cars for over 20 years. It’s great to have his number in my pocket for the big an small Jobs!

reviews.author: Diana Burgess
reviews.text: James was absolutely a God sent!!! A friend/coworker highly referred him and that really speaks volumes. My father is disabled and got into an accident yesterday and need a muffler tied up so he could get to Dr appt, he said no problem send me his info! What a true blessing he was!!

reviews.author: Shelley Curtis
reviews.text: So grateful I found James. Got my cars issue fixed QUICK. and never went a day without my car. I will go back, just hopefully not too soon.

reviews.author: Robin Nemeth
reviews.text: I had a great experience here. It was easy to set up the appointment. In fact, he took me in the very next day. Very friendly and very honest. I would definitely go back.

reviews.author: Kathy Jaedike
reviews.text: My son had car trouble as a student at Clemson. He answered our call on the weekend and had his car fixed for a reasonable price by early this week. Really appreciate the service and would highly recommend! Thank you!

reviews.author: Tara Visser
reviews.text: James was so nice and helpful. He got our car back to us quickly and helped us with our other that he could tell was having problems. Definitely recommend and will be going back next time!

reviews.author: Megan H
reviews.text: The absolute BEST mechanic around. He is quick, knowledgeable, honest and the best part is that he is open on the weekends! He was such a blessing to me in a time of desperation and will now be my regular mechanic!!

reviews.author: Jeffrey Phillips
reviews.text: Came through in the clutch with brand new brakes and rotors! Does what he says he will do and also when he says he will do it! I couldn't be more grateful with the service and the cost. I will tell everyone far and wide about this business!

reviews.author: Victor Kees II
reviews.text: Replaced water pump, thermostat, and belt....service was far above expectations. Price charged for repairs was more then fair and for an out of state customer he was an answered prayer. If lived in area, this would be my go to service repair shop for sure!

reviews.author: jpimn32
reviews.text: James ran a diagnostic on my engine. It took no time for him to complete the test. He informed me of the results in a manner that was very clear and easy to understand. I highly recommend James.

reviews.author: Brett Boesch
reviews.text: James helped me out 2 days after Christmas when most places were closed or couldn't fit me in until after the new year. The service was great and the price very reasonable. I would highly recommend it.

reviews.author: Marisa Bardwell
reviews.text: He's awesome at assessing and telling you the truth on what you need to know. He gets things done. Thanks James for awesome mechanic service and for upholding your business with integrity!

reviews.author: Mercedes Carey
reviews.text: Do not go to this guy! I bought a car from him was told it was in running condition. Broke down a week later. With multiple major problems. Didn't even give me the clean title so I can put it in my name. I asked him several times for the clean title in which I got blocked.

reviews.author: Clemson Web Design (clemsonwebdesign)
reviews.text: This man is a life saver. Couldnt get my oil filter off and was way past sue for a change. Swung by on labor day of all days and he popped it right off for me!

reviews.author: sedrick pickering
reviews.text: Awesome service and even better prices close to the pier(for those that are college students)!!! My alternator died and couldn’t find the part around not only did he found it but he installed it in the same day swiftly!!

reviews.author: crystal haymond
reviews.text: I texted James and he told me he could look at it right away. Fixed the issue with my brake lights in no time!!! On a SUNDAY!!! I think I’ve found a new mechanic.

reviews.author: Nathan Forrest
reviews.text: Cannot Recommend this business enough. James was willing to drive 10 hours to help me out, on top of a high level of expertise and honesty.

reviews.author: joe singleton
reviews.text: I do want to thank you for repairing my truck in a quick manner and for going out of your way to do it. I highly recommend him for your repairs

reviews.author: Kurtis Lewis
reviews.text: Had came from Columbia up to Clemson to visit and had some car trouble. This guy help me get it fix on the same day. Definitely Recommend going to him.

reviews.author: William Pate
reviews.text: my mom was a couple hundred miles from home and helpless this young man fixed her car at a very reasonable price and did it right . thank god for him and business

reviews.author: Michele Carpenter
reviews.text: James is very professional and went the extra mile to help a lady. His service was fast and he even delivered my car to me at work.

reviews.author: Lance Matzke
reviews.text: Great experience - can’t recommend enough! Helpful, efficient, great communication, honest, fast, and reliable. This is the shop to call.

reviews.author: Scott Glasing
reviews.text: Helped me out when I broke the brake line on my trailer. In and out in no time and reasonable. Great shop!

reviews.author: Rebecca Clement
reviews.text: Amazing job and fast. He even delivered our car to us. We will be going back in the future if needed.

reviews.author: mike long
reviews.text: JAMES DID A GREAT JOB OF TELLING ME ANF SHOWED ME WHAT WAS WRONG. IT ONLY TOOK A COUPLE OF HOURS AND I WAS BACK ON THE ROAD. HIS COSTS FOR LABOR AND PARTS WERE VERY REASONABLE. JAMES IS MY MACHANIC FOR THE FUTURE

reviews.author: Julie
reviews.text: Wow answered my call on a Friday evening. Got me right in the following morning and fixed within hours.

reviews.author: Jarred Purvis
reviews.text: James answered the phone and was happy to assist while coming through town with car trouble on a holiday weekend.

reviews.author: Lashay
reviews.text: Does a great Job all the time and the prices are reasonably. He doesn't try to rip people off. Just because you could doesn't mean you should and he doesn't. I do suggest bringing your car here for great work!!!

reviews.author: Adan Ramos
reviews.text: James is a great mechanic. He is fast and efficient with his time. If you need quality service call James!
